data: You release a shout that echoes across the battlefield towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Until the beginning of your next turn, if any other creature in range uses this move, they may double their damage dice on a hit. This multiplier can continue to stack to a maximum of 8x the damage dice, resetting if any of the attacks miss.
An appealing move that can be used repeatedly without boring the audience.
No penalty applied for repeating the move.
